sources.title: vllm-sr/d3-W4A16-GPTQ · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: vLLM Semantic Router serves d3-W4A16-GPTQ in Engine mode, which runs one model behind the System One API on your own machine, as it serves d3. It verifies the package against its MODEL_MANIFEST.json, as it verifies d3, and keeps the weights in int4 on the GPU, with its own int4 layers rather than d3q/.
